summary: iter-Jun-2026 — Esthetic Risk Assessment (ERA) full-stack verification. Backend: 6/6 existing tests re-passed + 2 additional regression tests (legacy 'Thin' biotype GET no 500; posterior-only case-report PDF generates without ERA section). Frontend (390x844 mobile web): anterior maxilla expansion (FDI 11) shows all 15 expected testids — era-anterior-hint, 9 dropdowns (smile_line, smile_type, gingival_biotype, adjacent_teeth_right/left, infection_at_site, ridge_condition, bone_level_adjacent, patient_expectations), read-only era-edentulous-span='Single tooth' with Low-risk pill, era-overall pending until first factor then 'Low risk' at 1/10 · 0 high · 0 medium · 1 low, era-incomplete shows '9 factor(s) still to grade'. No React Native / deprecated-package issues found in the new ERA code. No blocking bugs.
